description: This file defines a specific exception class CommandNotSupportedException used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a command is not supported by a particular API version. It includes builder patterns and static factory methods for creating exception instances, as well as metadata annotations.

classes.name: CommandNotSupportedException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a command is not supported in the current API version.

classes.name: CommandNotSupportedException.Builder
classes.description: A fluent builder class for constructing instances of CommandNotSupportedException.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance initialized with a specific version number.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance with a specified message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
